scope: S1..S8/C01..C12 are development-only; no new independent data before precision gate
primary_outcome: analytic operational regret / original loss_scale squared
failure_policy: execute reference action0, calculate its actual theoretical loss; preserve availability/conditional outcomes separately
forecast: structure-weighted Ridge alpha .01 fixed, feature transforms train-fold only, clip predictions to nonnegative0 as a predeclared forecast constraint, not failed-outcome imputation
models: M0 task+algorithm+graph observed features, M1 +skeleton, M2 +path, M3 +direction, M4 +skeleton+path, M5 +skeleton+direction, M6 +skeleton+direction+path
multiplicity: fixed sequence A then B; claim stable meaningful increment only if both structure bootstrap lower bounds exceed .01

planning.required_N_formula: ceil((1.96*paired_structure_sd/.005)^2), worst A/B and family-stratified variability; round up to multiple3, min18
planning.insufficient: if N or runtime exceeds cap, do not generate confirmatory graphs; report code/reanalysis/precision + limited MC calibration only

mc_calibration.n_selection: using known variance in development FCM before new draws; select smallest prefix meeting target else cap with warning
mc_calibration.role: actual do implementation/MC precision calibration, NOT independent new structures
